title: From Hourly to Annual: Understanding Your Pay and the Average NBA Salary
description: Convert your hourly rate to annual pay using 38 hours per week. Compare with the national minimum wage, award rates, casual loading, and see how the average NBA salary stacks up in
salarySummary: For a full‑time employee on the national minimum wage ($26.44/hour), the annual gross pay is about $26,445 before tax and super, based on 38 hours per week for 52 weeks.

faqs.q: How do I convert my hourly rate to an annual salary?
faqs.a: Multiply your hourly rate by the number of hours you work each week, then multiply by 52. For a standard full‑time week of 38 hours, the formula is: hourly rate × 38 × 52. The result is your gross annual pay before tax and super. For example, the national minimum wage of $26.44/hour gives $26.44 × 38 × 52 = $52,254.40 (rounded). The [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion) page has more details.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the national minimum wage and award rates?
faqs.a: The national minimum wage is the legal minimum for award‑free employees: $26.44/hour or $1,004.90/week for 38 hours. Most workers are covered by a modern award, which sets higher minimums for specific industries and roles. Awards also include penalty rates, allowances, and special rates for juniors, apprentices, and trainees. Casual employees get a 25% loading on top of the base rate (e.g., $33.05/hour for minimum wage). See the [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage) topic for more.

faqs.q: How is tax and super calculated on my annual pay?
faqs.a: Tax uses the 2026–27 resident tax brackets: no tax on the first $18,200, then 15% up to $45,000, 30% up to $135,000, 37% up to $190,000, and 45% above that. Medicare levy is generally 2% (with reduction thresholds from 2025–26 thresholds). Super guarantee is 12% of ordinary earnings, paid on top of your gross pay, up to the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Our [take‑home pay](/topics/take-home] estimator applies these rules. Remember, super is on top, not included in the annual figure.

bodyMarkdown:
## How to Convert Your Hourly Rate to Annual Pay

If you know your hourly rate or have a salary offer, the first step is to annualise it. The standard formula for a full‑time employee is simple: multiply your hourly rate by the hours you work each week, then multiply by 52 weeks. For most full‑time roles, we assume 38 hours per week is the standard week. For example, the national minimum wage of $26.44/hour gives $26.44 × 38 × 52 = $52,254.40 gross per year. If you work 40 hours, use 40 × 52. The [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion) page has a calculator.

### The Fortnightly View
A fortnight is two weeks. Your weekly pay is multiplied by 2. For the minimum wage, weekly $1,004.90 becomes $2,009.80 fortnightly. This helps when you budget or compare with a salary quoted fortnightly. The [the timesheet](/) lets you enter your hourly rate and see the annual, fortnight, and annual with super.

## National Minimum Wage, Award Rates, and Award Loading

The national minimum wage is $26.44/hour for a 38 hour week. This is the base for award free employees. Most workers are covered by a modern award. Awards set minimums for different industries and types of work. Some employees have special minimums for juniors (people under 21) or apprentices and trainees. Casual employees get a 25% loading on top. The casual loading is on top of the base rate. For example, the casual minimum wage is $33.05/hour including loading. The [casual loading](/topics/casual-loading) page explains more.

### Super Paid on Top
Super guarantee is 12% of ordinary earnings, paid on top of your gross pay. The maximum contribution base is $270,830. The super is not included in the annual figure. For the minimum wage, 12% of $52,254.40 is $6,270.53 per year. The [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) has more.

## Tax and the Average NBA Salary
While the average NBA salary is often cited in US dollars and not directly comparable, our calculator focuses on Australian pay rates. The average NBA salary is not provided in the search results or on site reference. The average NBA salary is not in the data. The Australian Bureau of Statistics average weekly earnings for full time adult ordinary time is $2,083.70 per week. All employees total earnings $1,579.20 per week. The average NBA salary is much higher, but the same formula applies. For a full time employee on the national minimum wage, the annual gross is $52,254.40. The tax uses the 2026–27 resident scale. No tax on the first $18,200, then 15% up to $45,000, 30% up to $135,000, 37% up to $190,000, 45% above. Medicare levy generally 2%. The take‑home pay is after tax. ## Using the Calculator
Use the [the timesheet](/) to enter your base hourly rate. A checkbox adds 25% casual loading on top. Never type a rate that already includes casual loading. The calculator uses the formula. The annual is hourly × hours per week × 52. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax is the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2027 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.

### The Fortnightly and Annual
For a full time employee on the national minimum wage, the fortnightly gross is $2,009.80. The annual gross is $52,254.40. After tax and Medicare, the take-home is lower. The super is on top. The average NBA salary is not in the data. The [reference tables](/data) have more.

## Conclusion
Understanding your annual pay from an hourly rate is straightforward. Use the formula, check the national minimum wage, award rates, and casual loading. The average NBA salary is not directly comparable. The calculator helps you. The [about the timesheet](/about) has more.
